hero.title: Six wings from first steps to [[school-ready]]
hero.text: From our warm Toddler Wing to our confident UKG Wing, every stage at Smart Start The Premium School is thoughtfully designed for your child's age, curiosity and lifelong growth.

items.name: Toddlers
items.wingTitle: Our Toddler Wing – Where Every Little Step Matters
items.description: At Smart Start – The Premium School, our Toddler Wing is not just a classroom, it is a warm, safe and joyful second home for your little one. We believe the toddler years are the most important foundation years, where a child learns not by books, but by touch, play, love and everyday experiences.
intro: At Smart Start – The Premium School, our Toddler Wing is not just a classroom, it is a warm, safe and joyful second home for your little one.
We believe the toddler years are the most important foundation years. This is the stage where a child learns not by books, but by touch, play, love and everyday experiences.
items.focusHeading: What We Focus On In Our Toddler Wing

focus.title: Toilet & Self-Care Training
focus.text: We gently help children become independent in daily routines like toilet training and hand washing, in a loving and stress-free way.

focus.title: Basic Etiquette & Good Manners
focus.text: Children learn to say please, thank you and sorry, to share, and to wait for their turn – through daily practice and gentle guidance.

focus.title: Eye-Hand Coordination
focus.text: Through stacking, sorting, colouring and play activities, children learn to coordinate what they see with what their hands do.

focus.title: Body Balancing & Motor Skills
focus.text: Activities like walking, jumping, dancing and outdoor play help children build balance, strength and body confidence.

focus.title: Speech & Language Development
focus.text: Through rhymes, stories and everyday conversations, children build vocabulary and learn to express themselves clearly.

focus.title: Recognition & Early Learning
focus.text: Children learn to recognize colours, shapes, animals, fruits and their own name, through play, songs and real objects.

promise: In our Toddler Wing, your child will not be rushed. They will be loved, understood and gently prepared for the next big step – Pre-School.
Because at Smart Start, we don't just teach toddlers, we nurture little beginnings.
objectives: Toilet & self-care independence in a stress-free way
Basic etiquette, sharing and waiting for their turn
Eye-hand coordination and body balancing
Early speech, vocabulary and recognition through play
activities: Stacking, sorting and colouring play
Walking, jumping, dancing and outdoor play
Rhymes, stories and everyday conversations
Songs and real-object recognition games

image.alt: Toddler playing with stacking rings and hoops on a soft play mat

items.name: Playgroup
items.wingTitle: Our Play Group Wing – Learning Through Colours & Play
items.description: At Smart Start – The Premium School, our Play Group kids do not learn by sitting and studying. They learn by seeing, touching, colouring and playing. That is why our Play Group is totally based on crayons, colours and fun activities.
intro: At Smart Start – The Premium School, our Play Group kids do not learn by sitting and studying. They learn by seeing, touching, colouring and playing.
That is why our Play Group is totally based on crayons, colours and fun activities.
items.focusHeading: What We Focus On In Our Play Group

focus.title: Alphabets & Numbers
focus.text: Children begin to recognize and identify A to Z and 1 to 10, through songs, rhymes, flashcards and playful activities.

focus.title: Shapes & Patterns
focus.text: Children learn to identify shapes like circle, square and triangle, and understand simple age-appropriate patterns through play and visuals.

focus.title: Colours & Creativity
focus.text: A child's life is full of colours. Through colouring and art activities, children learn to recognize colours and express their imagination freely.

focus.title: Tracing & Colouring Based Learning
focus.text: Tracing lines, shapes and letters helps children develop pencil grip and pre-writing skills, all in a fun and stress-free way.

focus.title: Social & General Awareness
focus.text: Children learn about themselves, their family, animals, fruits, vehicles and the world around them, building early general awareness.

focus.title: Speech & Communication Skills
focus.text: Through stories, rhymes, group talk and daily conversations, children enhance their speech and learn to communicate and converse with confidence.

focus.title: Sports & Field Activities
focus.text: We have introduced fun field activities for our Play Group children. Through games, running, jumping and group play, children build strength, balance, teamwork and a love for staying active from an early age.

promise: In our Play Group, every day is a colourful adventure. Your child will learn to recognize, speak, share and shine – while playing, laughing and loving to come to school.
Because at Smart Start, we believe – Play is the best way to Learn.
objectives: Recognize A to Z, 1 to 10, shapes and patterns
Build pre-writing skills through tracing and colouring
Grow early general awareness and speech confidence
Develop strength, balance and teamwork through sports
activities: Crayons, colouring and creative art
Flashcards, songs, rhymes and group talk
Line, shape and letter tracing games
Running, jumping and outdoor field activities

image.alt: Toddler stacking colourful cups on artificial grass outdoors

items.name: Pre-Nursery
items.wingTitle: Our Pre-Nursery Wing – First Step Towards Academics
items.description: At Smart Start – The Premium School, our Pre-Nursery Wing is designed as the first step towards academics. Specially made as a gentle bridge between play-based learning and formal learning, it prepares your child to enter Nursery with confidence, not fear.
intro: At Smart Start – The Premium School, our Pre-Nursery Wing is designed as the first step towards academics.
This wing is specially made to prepare your child for Nursery. That is why it is called Pre-Nursery – a gentle bridge between play-based learning and formal learning.
items.focusHeading: What We Focus On In Our Pre-Nursery

focus.title: Introduction to Pencil
focus.text: In this wing, we introduce the pencil for the first time. As per NEP guidelines and medical advice, a child should hold a pencil only after the age of 2.5 years, when their tiny fingers and muscles are ready. We follow this strictly and teach the correct pencil grip in a fun and pressure-free way.

focus.title: Writing in Four Lines
focus.text: Children learn to write in four lines, which helps them understand line discipline, letter formation and neat writing from the very beginning.

focus.title: Preparation for Nursery
focus.text: All activities in Pre-Nursery are planned to make children ready for Nursery – so they enter the next class with confidence, not fear.

focus.title: Enhanced Communication Skills
focus.text: Through daily conversations, storytelling, rhymes and group activities, children learn to speak clearly and express their thoughts better.

focus.title: Stronger Recognition
focus.text: Children strengthen their recognition of alphabets, numbers, colours, shapes and objects, and begin to connect them with the real world.

focus.title: Etiquette & Good Habits
focus.text: We continue to nurture etiquette and good habits so children grow into polite, well-mannered learners.

promise: In our Pre-Nursery, your child takes their first confident step towards academics – with a pencil in hand, a smile on face, and a heart ready to learn.
Because at Smart Start, we prepare children not just for the next class, but for a lifetime of learning.
objectives: Age-appropriate NEP-aligned pencil introduction (2.5+ years)
Four-line writing discipline and letter formation
Clear speaking, storytelling and stronger recognition
Smooth, fear-free readiness for Nursery
activities: Guided pencil-grip and four-line writing practice
Daily conversations, rhymes and storytelling
Real-world alphabet, number and shape activities
Good habits and etiquette routines

image.alt: Boy finger-painting grapes on an activity sheet

items.name: Nursery
items.wingTitle: Our Nursery Wing – Where Learning Becomes Joyful
items.description: At Smart Start – The Premium School, our Nursery Wing is where children move from learning through play to learning with purpose. After Pre-Nursery, your child is now ready to read, write, think and explore – with confidence and curiosity.
intro: At Smart Start – The Premium School, our Nursery Wing is where children move from learning through play to learning with purpose.
After Pre-Nursery, your child is now ready to read, write, think and explore – with confidence and curiosity.
items.focusHeading: What We Focus On In Our Nursery

focus.title: Phonics & Reading
focus.text: Children learn sounds of letters through phonics, which helps them read small words, sentences and stories independently and with confidence.

focus.title: Writing Skills
focus.text: Children practice writing capital and small letters, words and simple sentences in four lines, with correct formation and neatness.

focus.title: Numbers & Early Maths
focus.text: Children learn counting, number names, after-before-between numbers, and simple concepts like big-small, more-less and shapes, through fun activities.

focus.title: Introduction to Hindi
focus.text: We introduce Hindi in Nursery itself, so that children do not feel overloaded in LKG. They learn Hindi swar, vyanjan and simple words in a fun and easy way, at their own pace.

focus.title: English & Hindi Language
focus.text: Children build vocabulary, learn rhymes, stories and daily conversation in both English and Hindi, so they can express themselves in both languages.

focus.title: General Awareness & EVS
focus.text: Children learn about themselves, family, seasons, animals, plants, transport and good habits – connecting classroom learning with the real world.

focus.title: Communication & Confidence
focus.text: Through show-and-tell, rhymes, storytelling and class activities, children overcome hesitation and learn to speak confidently in front of others.

focus.title: Etiquette, Discipline & Sports
focus.text: We continue to build good manners, discipline and values, along with sports and field activities, for a healthy body, active mind and teamwork.

promise: In our Nursery, your child does not just learn to read and write – they learn to think, ask questions, and express themselves.
Because at Smart Start, we believe every child who enters Nursery should leave ready, confident and excited for KG and beyond.
objectives: Phonics reading and neat four-line writing
Early maths, counting and number concepts
Gentle early introduction to Hindi swar and vyanjan
Bilingual expression, EVS and stage confidence
activities: Phonics games and interactive sound books
English and Hindi rhymes, stories and conversation
Show-and-tell and class speaking activities
Sports, field games and EVS exploration

image.alt: Boy touching an interactive alphabet sound book at his desk

items.name: LKG
items.wingTitle: Our LKG Wing – Building Strong Foundations
items.description: At Smart Start – The Premium School, our LKG Wing is where learning becomes deeper, clearer and more confident. Since children have already been introduced to Hindi in Nursery, they do not feel any burden in LKG and are ready to read, write and think independently.
intro: At Smart Start – The Premium School, our LKG Wing is where learning becomes deeper, clearer and more confident.
Since children have already been introduced to Hindi in Nursery, they do not feel any burden in LKG. They are now ready to read, write and think independently.
items.focusHeading: What We Focus On In Our LKG

focus.title: English Reading & Writing
focus.text: Children read and write three-letter words, small sentences and short stories with the help of phonics, and develop neat and confident writing.

focus.title: Hindi Reading & Writing
focus.text: Children learn to read and write Hindi words, matras and simple sentences with ease, because their base was already built in Nursery.

focus.title: Maths & Logical Thinking
focus.text: Children learn counting up to 100, number names, tables, addition, subtraction, and concepts like greater than, less than and place value, through practical activities.

focus.title: EVS & General Awareness
focus.text: Children learn about our body, family, community helpers, seasons, animals, plants, transport and festivals, and develop curiosity about the world.

focus.title: Communication & Speaking Skills
focus.text: Through storytelling, rhymes, conversations, show-and-tell and class discussions, children learn to speak fluently and express their ideas clearly.

focus.title: Moral Values & Etiquette
focus.text: We focus on good manners, respect, honesty, sharing, discipline and helping others – values that make children good human beings along with good learners.

focus.title: Sports, Art & Field Activities
focus.text: Through sports, art, craft, dance and field activities, children develop physical fitness, creativity, teamwork and a happy, active lifestyle.

promise: In our LKG, your child becomes an independent learner – who can read, write, speak and think with confidence.
Because at Smart Start, we don't rush children, we build them step by step – strong in studies, rich in values.
objectives: Fluent English and Hindi word, matra and sentence skills
Maths up to 100, tables, addition, subtraction and place value
EVS curiosity, storytelling and clear class discussions
Strong moral values, art, dance and physical fitness
activities: Phonics reading, Hindi matra practice and neat writing
Practical maths activities and logical thinking games
Show-and-tell, storytelling and festival projects
Sports, art, craft, dance and field activities

image.alt: Girl pointing at an Independence Day activity worksheet at her desk

items.name: UKG
items.wingTitle: Our UKG Wing – Ready For Primary, Ready For Life
items.tagline: Ready For Primary, Ready For Life
items.description: At Smart Start – The Premium School, our UKG Wing is the final and most important step of pre-primary education. Here, your child is not just prepared for Class 1, but prepared to be confident, independent and responsible in every way.
intro: At Smart Start – The Premium School, our UKG Wing is the final and most important step of pre-primary education.
Here, your child is not just prepared for Class 1, but prepared to be confident, independent and responsible in every way.
items.focusHeading: What We Focus On In Our UKG

focus.title: Advanced English
focus.text: Children read and write sentences, paragraphs and small stories, learn opposite words, rhyming words, and one-many, and speak in English with fluency and confidence.

focus.title: Advanced Hindi
focus.text: Children read and write Hindi sentences and stories with matras, learn vachan, vilom and simple grammar, and speak in Hindi with clarity.

focus.title: Maths & Mental Ability
focus.text: Children learn addition and subtraction with carry and borrow, tables, skip counting, time, money, and simple word problems, building strong mental maths skills.

focus.title: EVS & Life Skills
focus.text: Children learn about our environment, traffic rules, safety, good habits, festivals, national symbols and community helpers, and develop practical life understanding.

focus.title: Communication & Public Speaking
focus.text: Through speeches, rhymes, storytelling, role play and stage activities, children overcome stage fear and learn to speak confidently in front of everyone.

focus.title: Discipline, Values & Leadership
focus.text: We focus on self-discipline, responsibility, kindness, honesty and teamwork. Children learn to take care of their belongings, help others and become little leaders.

focus.title: Sports, Art & Holistic Development
focus.text: Through sports, yoga, dance, art and field activities, children develop fitness, creativity, focus and a balanced personality.

promise: In our UKG, your child completes their pre-primary journey as a confident reader, writer, speaker and thinker – fully ready for Class 1 and beyond.
Because at Smart Start, we don't just prepare children for the next class, we prepare them for life.
objectives: Fluent English and Hindi stories, grammar and writing
Carry/borrow maths, tables, time, money and word problems
EVS life skills, public speaking and stage leadership
Sports, yoga, dance, discipline and Class 1 readiness
activities: Paragraph writing, story reading and grammar practice
Mental maths, time, money and word-problem games
Speeches, role play, stage shows and graduation
Sports, yoga, dance, art and leadership roles

image.alt: Child in a blue graduation gown holding a scroll and a certificate
